context: Either (a) map each mode to catalog/data_path defaults in from_config with explicit --platform-option winning, or (b) validate and reject a deployment_mode that contradicts the resolved catalog/storage axes. (b) is smaller and cannot silently change what a run measures; prefer it unless mode-as-shorthand is wanted.
description: adapter_factory._resolve_deployment_mode() accepts --platform ducklake:<mode> and sets config['deployment_mode'], but benchbox/platforms/ducklake.py never reads it, so 'ducklake:postgres_catalog_s3' silently runs a local DuckDB-file catalog on local disk - the user believes they selected a deployment and got something else. The four modes are correctly MODELLED after w10 (catalog backend x storage location) and their descriptions say the real selection is --platform-option catalog= plus the data_path scheme, but nothing stops a contradictory selection.

preserves.behavior: Runs that pass no deployment_mode keep working exactly as today

verifications.description: A contradictory deployment_mode no longer silently runs the wrong deployment
verifications.expected: all pass; new test covers ducklake:postgres_catalog_s3

work_units.evidence: benchbox/platforms/ducklake.py: _DEPLOYMENT_MODE_AXES + _resolve_catalog_with_deployment_mode() + _warn_if_deployment_mode_contradicts_storage() wired into from_config. Mode now fills the catalog axis when unspecified; explicit --platform-option stays authoritative (must-preserve) and a contradiction warns instead of passing silently. Storage axis warns rather than defaulting - a bucket cannot be invented. Verified: mode alone -> postgres (was duckdb), no mode -> unchanged, explicit sqlite wins over mode, s3 mode + local path warns
work_units.summary: Make deployment_mode either apply the axes or reject a contradictory selection
